WaterWheel defaults to north-south=1; native controls place NS before WE.
All eight facing values for each of three siege engines match native actual building fields.
BoltThrower native input order parts/mechanisms/chains/bins differs from DFHack helper.

waterwheel_animation_native.scope: Synthetic completed machinery above existing three-cell permanent river flow; adjacent upper-level support prepared, river water unchanged. Native machine attachment and gear toggles; natural simulation advances, no assigned power or machine positions. Native Wheel artwork sampled during natural powered ticks. Not natural construction or minecart effects.
waterwheel_animation_native.observed_rule: Completed NS wheel uses WATER_WHEEL_NS_1 for even machine visual_phase and NS_2 for odd phase; all1080 captured cells match. Zero-output samples retain phase-selected art; output alone is not frame selector.
limits: Natural powered capture covers phases0..5/NS; controlled_states extends both orientations, signed extremes, missing machine, planned/completed, output flag and material variation including top row.
Runtime fixed-frame/material behavior remains to be corrected.

controlled_states.initial_capture: build/waterwheel-states-native-20261023-224546 (same312states,42footprinttextures; signpost layer omitted and subsequently added)

rules.rule: Completed positive odd machine phases select frame2; all other sampled signed phases and absent machine select frame1. Planned always frame1 half opacity. Completed first item palette, empty painted; output flag irrelevant. Both orientations and signpost top row verified.

capture.scope: Paused synthetic wheels; both orientations, signed phase extremes, absent machine(-129), planned/complete, forced output flag, first-item variations, granite building material; both graphic layers including overhang. Diagnostic only.

limits: Synthetic paused states, not natural construction or power. Natural powered observations and natural construction are recorded separately.
One contained item or no item; multiple contained-item precedence is not independently tested here.
All building material is granite; planned/empty artwork ignores it in these cases.

implementation.phase_contract: waterwheel_machine_position: signed byte; -129 unknown, 0 absent machine
implementation.material: first contained item actual material; planned/empty painted
implementation.rendering: Frame1 resident geometry; shared machine phase texture selects native frame2 only when signed phase remainder is1. Pixel cell sizes are normalized to UV offsets.

verification.oracle: GPU pixels compared to static meshes selecting the independently established native atlas cells, plus geometry identity and page lifecycle regressions.

capture.scope: Synthetic completed WaterWheel with real registered seed items moved into/out of it; natural ticks publish facts. Not natural construction or minecart effects.

transport.limits: Synthetic completed wheel with real registered items and controlled idle machine phases. Verifies exported first-item facts, not native multi-item artwork precedence or natural construction.

windmill_rendering_native.scope: Paused synthetic windmill; nine orientation vectors -1..1, ten signed rotations, planned/complete, working0/1, none/oak/iron first item, granite building material; includes signpost overhang. Diagnostic art, not natural completion or wind-power effects.

rules.orientation: orient_x east-positive, orient_y south-positive; zero vector uses S; all eight cardinal/diagonal directions retained even when planned
rules.frame: complete and rotation!=0 ->2; otherwise1, including negative nonzero rotation
rules.material: complete uses first item actual material; absent and planned retain painted pixels
rules.working: working flag does not affect artwork

windmill_rendering_native.limits: Orientations outside -1..1 and multiple contained-item artwork precedence are not tested; out-of-range native vectors publish unknown orientation.

implementation.contract: windmill_orient_x/y paired -2 unknown or native -1..1; windmill_rotation -129 unknown or native signed byte; first contained item material
implementation.renderer: Stable S1 base geometry and a presentation-only packed orientation/frame value in the shared machine texture. Planned orientation uses alpha-blended machine_ghost shader; rotation changes do not rebuild geometry.

verification.status: GPU passed with only documented Godot diagnostics; core19 passed

capture.scope: Synthetic completed Windmill with real registered seed items moved into/out of it; natural ticks publish facts. Not natural construction or minecart effects.

transport.limits: Synthetic completed windmill with real registered items, controlled orientation/rotation and large timers; natural ticks publish facts. Not natural construction or wind power effects.

rules.frame: Complete: frame2 iff linked machine signed phase %2==1; absent machine0, negative odd and all other values frame1. Planned always frame1. Gear disengagement does not alter draw when machine phase is held constant.
rules.axles: Material-colored shaft under painted/uncolored fittings, at every footprint cell. First contained item actual material; empty and planned painted. Horizontal native is_vertical distinguishes NS/WE even at1x1.
rules.gear: First contained item material when complete, painted if empty; planned painted frame1. Gear planned alpha rounds half upward; axle planned alpha truncates half.
rules.connections: No south-axle graphic at the gear tile in648 neighbor cases. Native graph-connected south NS axle also retains ordinary gear and shaft/fittings art throughout five samples, including after250 ticks; no extra surrounding graphic.

axles_gears_rendering_native.limits: Synthetic diagnostic building states, not natural construction or powered operation. Connected probe needed one recorded resume after native frame-one pause. Neighbor tests do not prove the south-axle token is globally unused.

implementation.rendering: Cached colored shafts with raw fittings; native planned alpha before mipmaps. Shader phase updates preserve resident geometry.

transport.limits: Synthetic completed buildings and registered seed items; controlled machine phase, not natural construction or powered-operation acceptance.

planned_alpha_regression.behavior: Native floor-half source alpha before mipmaps, white vertex tint; completed phase/resource behavior retained.
planned_alpha_regression.pixel_reference: planned_machine_pixels.json; existing tests separately assert layout, phase and resource ownership.
